title: Choose from named options
objective: Declare a kind with a fixed set of choices, and use match to act on whichever one a value holds.

body.text: A kind lists the choices a value can be. Each choice starts with is a. make picks one choice, and match runs the when block for that choice. If a when block is missing, the compiler stops and names the choice it misses.

body.title: Match a traffic light
body.code:
kind light
    is a red
    is a yellow
    is a green

make signal equal to a red
match signal
    when a red
        say "stop"
    when a yellow
        say "slow"
    when a green
        say "go"

body.text: A choice can also carry a value. Here success holds the text done. The when line gives the value a name, v, so the block can use it.

body.title: A choice that carries a value
body.code:
kind result
    is a success with value of type text
    is a failure with message of type text

make ok equal to a success with value "done"
match ok
    when a success with value v
        say v
    when a failure with message m
        say m

body.prompt: The light is green, but the program prints stop. Make it print go.
body.starter:
kind light
    is a red
    is a yellow
    is a green

make signal equal to a red
match signal
    when a red
        say "stop"
    when a yellow
        say "slow"
    when a green
        say "go"
body.solution:
kind light
    is a red
    is a yellow
    is a green

make signal equal to a green
match signal
    when a red
        say "stop"
    when a yellow
        say "slow"
    when a green
        say "go"
